newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Mabuhay Vinyl IPO likely oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Mabuhay Vinyl IPO likely oversubscribed.

text.p: The initial public offering of Mabuhay Vinyl Corp is likely to be oversubscribed based on firm sales commitments made by member-brokers of the Philippine Stock Exchange, lead domestic underwriter BPI Capital Corp said on Friday.
The brokers subscribed to a total of 130 million shares versus the 111 million shares offered for distribution through the Philippine Stock Exchange, BPI said.
Under the new IPO distribution rules being implemented by the stock exchange, member-brokers have a three-day period within which to commit to sell a specified number of shares.

A total of 223.187 million Mabuhay Vinyl shares are being offered to the public at 1.90 pesos each equivalent to 9.9 times projected 1997 earnings, BPI said. The rest of the shares have been allocated to the underwriters, who forsee good demand, it said.
The offering started on January 13 and will end on January 24. The listing date has been set for February 5.
Mabuhay Vinyl is the largest caustic soda and polyvinyl chloride resin manufacturer in the Philippines.
